about: Questions where the right data is missing but a look-alike exists. Run each through the Data Genie, the Data Scientist, Election Analytics and Business Intelligence before a publish that changes their instructions. Pass = the answer says plainly what is missing (or gives the real figure with its source) and never presents the look-alike as the answer.

questions.ask: How many new communities did Council approve in 2026?
questions.pass: 9 so far (6 + 3 on Oct 27), 4 pending at budget, from data:new_communities

questions.ask: What is Calgary Transit ridership this year?
questions.pass: says ridership is not in the site's data (Calgary Transit reports); web search for the real figure where available

questions.ask: How many homeless people are in Calgary?
questions.pass: points to the Point-in-Time count; never counts shelters as people

questions.ask: How many homes were completed in Calgary in 2025?
questions.pass: says permits are not completions; names CMHC completions

questions.ask: How many traffic collisions were there in Ward 5 last year?
questions.pass: says live incidents are not collision statistics

questions.ask: How many businesses closed in Calgary this year?
questions.pass: says licences issued show openings, not closures

questions.ask: How did Ward 5's councillor vote on the 2025 budget?
questions.pass: gives the vote record's date range and says 2025 is outside it, never 'no vote'
names the area the figure covers (Calgary CMA) and its source and month

questions.ask: How many km of separated cycle tracks does Calgary have?
